title: Resort Activity Waiver
scenario: A resort vendor sends a waiver link that also asks for card and passport details.

answers.A: Upload your passport and card details to the waiver link.
answers.B: Complete the waiver at the resort or through its official booking system.
answers.C: Complete the waiver but leave the payment fields blank.
answers.D: Ask what information the activity legally needs before sharing it.

explanation: A waiver may need health or emergency information, but it should not quietly collect unnecessary payment and identity data.
proTip: Read what the form collects before agreeing to the activity.
